questions.stem: What is the purpose of the earth wire in a three-pin plug?

options.text: It carries the current to the appliance
It completes the circuit by providing a return path
It provides a safe path for current to flow to the ground if a fault occurs
It reduces the voltage of the supply

questions.explanation: The earth wire is a safety feature. If a fault causes the metal case of an appliance to become live, the earth wire provides a low-resistance path for current to flow safely to the ground. This causes a large current that blows the fuse, disconnecting the supply.

questions.stem: What is the advantage of a residual current device (RCD) over a fuse?

options.text: It detects differences in current between live and neutral wires and switches off much faster than a fuse
It does not need an earth wire

questions.explanation: An RCD continuously monitors the current in the live and neutral wires. If it detects a difference (indicating current is leaking to earth, possibly through a person), it disconnects the circuit within milliseconds — much faster than a fuse can blow.
